content.content: 1. Necessity: refusal needs the shape grammar for what a verb is — without it, unknown-word refusal is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Refusal is where shape defends the verbs; the gate keeps the use sound without testing refusal itself.
